- Game Hub: the shelf is Boxshelf's own screen (3D shelf, cases you turn and open) run in a WebView; the games, Play, hiding and the stats are Pulse's. Case style (PC/Steam by default, Custom, PS5, PS4, Xbox 360, Switch) is chosen in Settings. Real Steam art (cover, hero, logo) for games Steam has; the Google Play picture otherwise. A light Compose shelf stays as "Shelf, light". Sounds: the shelf's own, and the launcher's click when a game starts.
- Lyrics: the AI window shows how far it is, how long, and the lines as they come; it runs in the background service, so closing the window or pressing Back does not stop it, and the lyrics appear when they are ready. The editor has the AI button, lyrics can be written by hand, and the lyrics search is tried first for each song.
- Lyrics status comes from a persistent background index (nothing is read again and again); the lists, the batch and the picker use it.
- Keyboard: the three suggestions have equal places; the bar for a hardware keyboard no longer fills the screen; the password-manager chips stay behind the bar.
- Picker: photo thumbnails are turned by their EXIF orientation.
- Icons: presets (AMOLED, Material Glass, Light, Dark) and Material Glass colours in the icon maker; Pulse's own icon can be made too (as a home-screen shortcut).
